paper_title: DART Distilling Autoregressive Reasoning to Silent Thought
caption: Accuracy and inference time on GSM8K with varying C, the number of ST tokens.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between the number of ST tokens and both accuracy and inference time. The x-axis is labeled "ST Token Number C" and is linear, ranging from 0 to 30 with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is split into two scales. The left y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and is linear, ranging from 36 to 43. The right y-axis is labeled "Inference time (ms)" and is linear, ranging from 33 to 40. A blue line with a circular marker and solid style represents accuracy, starting at 36.88% at x = 0 and increasing to 42.33% at x = 5, decreasing to 41.23% at x = 10, then increasing to 42.83% at x = 20, and ending at 42.33% at x = 30. A red, square-marker line, represented with a solid style, illustrates inference time, starting at 39.17 ms at x = 0, decreasing slightly to 38.83 ms at x = 5, and remaining constant at 38.83 ms until x = 20, then decreasing to 38.83 ms at x = 30.
